meta.title: Cursor/cursorignore
meta.body_summary: Adds .cursorignore to prevent Cursor AI from indexing sensitive files and large build artifacts, claiming improved AI editor performance and security.

perf_labels.notes: PR adds .cursorignore for editor perf, but closed immediately because wrong base branch; no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1648 changed lines across 36 files, this is a large diff by absolute volume, but mostly due to a merge commit bringing in many unrelated changes; the actual intended change is only a 298-line .cursorignore addition. The PR was closed immediately because the wrong base branch was used, which is consistent with a process error rather than the change content.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR author closed the PR because they used the main branch as the base instead of the dev branch, as indicated in the comment: 'wrong base. used main as a base for this, should have been dev'.
review_details.performance_claim: The .cursorignore file is intended to reduce AI editor indexing latency by excluding sensitive and generated files.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by author with comment 'wrong base. used main as a base for this, should have been dev'.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple configuration file addition was closed due to incorrect base branch, illustrating that Agent PRs can fail on workflow conventions even when the code change is trivial.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or profiling evidence for editor indexing improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No merge, so no regression handling occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Adds a .cursorignore file that excludes sensitive files (keys, credentials, deployment configs) and large generated artifacts (build outputs, node_modules, circuit/contract compilation outputs) from Cursor AI to prevent indexing slowdown.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changed files are from an automatic merge of the dev branch into main, unrelated to the cursorignore change.
change_trajectory: Merge commit cb2ef913 brings in dev branch changes (contracts, circuits, build scripts).
PR closed immediately after creation due to wrong base branch.
